rule_ko: 헤드라인에서 to부정사는 '~할 예정이다'입니다. will과 is going to를 쓸 자리가 없어서 to 하나로 줄인 겁니다.

examples.hl: Fed to hold rates as inflation cools
examples.full: The Fed will hold rates as inflation cools.

examples.hl: UK to ban disposable vapes from June
examples.full: The UK will ban disposable vapes from June.

examples.hl: Apple to unveil new headset next week
examples.full: Apple is going to unveil a new headset next week.

quiz_hl: Seoul to host climate summit in 2027
